description: Our Monero p2pool (mini + nano sidechains) plus Monero network state: per-sidechain hashrate, miners, sidechain height/difficulty, blocks found, last block age, this node's workers, fee and the non-custodial flag. When to use: solo/p2pool mining economics on Monero, sidechain health, or which stratum endpoint to point a rig at. Do not use: plain node RPC state → xmr_node_status.
name: xmr_pool_status
